text: You prove the number by sending us one WhatsApp message; we do not keep the number for this.
page: Privacy notice, section 4D, Sign in with your phone number
proof: 0093_phone_sign_in.sql:45-52: the search reads the number from the proof and stores only the proof's nonce in member_find_tries (rows older than 1 day deleted, line 49). phoneInbound.js:23-24 and :247: the check keeps keyed hashes; the encrypted number is emptied when the proof is handed out.

text: Your PIN is kept only in a coded form that cannot be turned back into the PIN.
page: Privacy notice, section 4E, Gym owners and staff
proof: 0034_signin_pin.sql:140 and :272 store crypt(pin, gen_salt('bf', 10)) in gym_staff_pins.pin_hash (column at :63); :171 checks a PIN by re-hashing, never by reading it back.

text: Wrong attempts are recorded too.
proof: 0034_signin_pin.sql:192-198 inserts a gym_signin_fails row for every wrong try; 0028_hq_breakglass_and_logs.sql:134-135 has a trigger that copies each one into gym_access_log as sign_in_failed (:30).

text: We check that it is your number, and keep only a coded form of it.
proof: The check itself keeps only keyed hashes (phoneInbound.js:23-24, number emptied at :247; old rows deleted after 2 days, phoneCode.js:397-401). But when a gym is started the checked number is also written in plain text into trial_phones (0061_phone_codes.sql:62 column phone text, :179 insert), with no expiry found, and it outlives the gym (:63 on delete set null).

text: Someone could still match that code to an address, so we protect it like other personal data.
page: Privacy notice, section 4E, Your acceptance of our terms
proof: The address is stored only as sha256 of gym id + address (0033_terms_acceptance.sql:45, :91). Who can read gym_terms_acceptance was not checked, so 'protect it like other personal data' has no proof.

text: Signing that device out deletes the copy.
page: Privacy notice, section 4E, the gym's own records
proof: cloud.ts:1027 and :555 call saved.clear(); savedCopy.ts:140-141 empties the IndexedDB store. But savedCopy.ts:4-6 says everything made offline (check-ins, payments, new members) sits in the waiting list in outbox.ts, 'which is NOT cleared on sign-out'. No test opened.

text: The AI Assistant (gym owners only): what the owner types or says goes to Anthropic's Claude AI so it can understand the request and get a message or a change ready.
page: Privacy notice, section 4E, The AI Assistant
proof: assist.js:623-624 masks the owner's text and sends the masked text to Claude; :639 puts the numbers back in the answer. 'Gym owners only' was not checked in code.

text: A member's name goes only if the owner says it.
page: Privacy notice, section 4E, The AI Assistant
proof: assist.js:242 builds the gym facts sent with a request: gym name, today, plans, batches, trainers' first names; no member list. :271 tells the model member names are only the ones the owner says.

text: When the owner asks it to write a workout plan, Claude gets the goal, level, days a week and session length he picks, his short notes on focus and equipment (including any injury he mentions, with mobile numbers and emails hidden) and the names of the gym's exercises; never the member's name or records.
page: Privacy notice, section 4E, The AI Assistant
proof: assistPlan.js:84-86 masks the focus and equipment words; :98 leaves out an exercise name with a phone or email in it; :8-10 lists what is sent (no member); :308 the plan comes back assigned to nobody. Test named for this at assistPlan.test.mjs:119, not opened.

text: A spoken request goes through our server to Groq, which turns it into text; neither we nor Groq keep the recording.
page: Privacy notice, section 4E, The AI Assistant
proof: assist.js:737-740: when the secret SARVAM_API_KEY is set, the recording goes to Sarvam (api.sarvam.ai, :70) FIRST and Groq is only the second choice (:31, :824-834). Sarvam is not named in the notice. Whether that key is set live: unknown. Our side: :815-834 only counts seconds and returns the text, no write of the sound. What Groq or Sarvam keep: unknown.

text: We keep each request, what the owner did with it and the credits it used for 400 days, so the owner can see them in the admin app.
page: Privacy notice, section 4E, The AI Assistant
proof: 0071_ai_assistant.sql:28 gym_ai_tasks holds the request, status, credits and result; :247 and :381 delete tasks older than 400 days. The admin app screen that shows them was not opened.

text: After 400 days the request and its words are deleted; only the number of credits used stays, for our accounts.
page: Privacy notice, section 4E, The AI Assistant
proof: 0071_ai_assistant.sql:247-249 (on each save) and :381-384 (nightly, called from deploy/hq/worker.js:206) delete tasks and clear the spend note after 400 days; the credit row stays. Test step 8b at supabase/tests/0071_ai_assistant.sql:192-209 checks the note is cleared and the credits row stays.

text: MettleUp support looks at a gym's records only in a short window.

text: In an emergency, such as a fault that stops the desk, we open it for up to 1 hour and write down why.
proof: hq_open_emergency: minutes must be 15, 30 or 60 and the reason kind from a short list (0028:225); a written reason of 10 letters or more is required (:226); the grant and reason are saved (:229-233).

text: Every look is recorded, and the owner can see each one in the admin app.

Looks made with the Supabase owner login are not: 0097_direct_read_log.sql:5-6 'until now only HQ's own looks were', and line 1 of that file says NOT APPLIED LIVE.
